أسبكر (form IVq)
# أَسْبَكِرُّ (ʔasbakirru) /ʔas.ba.kir.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْبَكَرَّ (isbakarra)
# أَسْبَكِرَّ (ʔasbakirra) /ʔas.ba.kir.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْبَكَرَّ (isbakarra)
# أَسْبَكِرِّ (ʔasbakirri) /ʔas.ba.kir.ri/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْبَكَرَّ (isbakarra)
